results.scope: Compile, real A5 execution and numerical correctness of existing PA implementations. Not latency benchmarking, not all shapes or complete model validation.

routes.name: PyPTO2 ordinary

tested_variant.entry: ctrl_perf_kernel with cache views rebuilt after scatter_update

case.mode: prolog + KV append + single-token PA decode
case.reference: Independent dense CPU FP32 attention after CPU prolog and KV append, preserving FP16 casts

limitations: Original source is a performance guard without a numerical golden.
Observed backend output uses the pre-update cache; rebuilding both views after updates restores the tested append semantics. No specific compiler pass or runtime root cause established.
Local correction tested for B=4, one prolog batch tile. Not a replacement validation of the original B=16 performance guard.

routes.name: PyPTO2 Pro

cases.assertion: All three page sizes match CPU reference and are bit-identical to each other

cases.mode: additional single-token decode using the original _run_case

routes.page_mapping: randomly shuffled pages in an overallocated garbage-filled pool
routes.reference: Existing CPU FA-flow reference with BF16 probability rounding

routes.name: PyPTO3 + Simpler + PTOAS
routes.mode: single-token MQA, existing multi-task PTOAS implementation
routes.page_mapping: random physical page IDs; repetitions allowed
routes.reference: Existing CPU page-wise online reference with BF16 probabilities and FP32 online update
limitations: All requests within a case share the same context length.
Qwen3-14B fused SPMD PA has only a2a3/a2a3sim test CLI choices in this checkout; its A5 path was not ported or tested.
Scale 1.0 is the existing test default, unlike other routes.

routes.name: CANNBot DSL
limitations: KV lengths in these tests are full pages. No partial-KV-page or heterogeneous-batch-length coverage.
Multiquery cases use no causal mask.
Passing implementation comes from the DSL examples; arena flash_attn is not used as native PA evidence.

limitations: Not a performance comparison or exhaustive shape suite.

case.reference: Independent dense CPU FP32 paged decode, output rounded to BF16

compile.npu_scheduling: inductor_npu_ext.NPUScheduling asserted before and after execution

No native single-kernel PA or megaKernel claim.
